breeds patchily in high Arctic (mainly) tundra of Holarctic from northwestern and eastern Greenland, north-central Siberia, islands north of north-central and northeastern Siberia, and northern Chukotskiy Peninsula (northeastern Siberia); winters coasts worldwide from temperate zone to tropics; in Indian Ocean mainly western Australia, and in Pacific in New Zealand but rare on other remote islands
breeds montane tundra of Alaska mainland (except far northern) and Yukon (northwestern Canada); winters rocky coasts from southeastern Alaska to Tierra del Fuego
breeds montane tundra of northeastern Siberia from Yakutsk eastward to Anadyr Peninsula; winters coasts from northeastern Arabian Peninsula eastward to Taiwan, Philippines, and Australia

breeds tundra and steppe of northwestern Europe from Scandinavia southward to northern Ukraine and eastward to far eastern Siberia; winters from central Europe southward through Africa, eastward through southern Asia to central Japan southward to Philippines
breeds low Arctic tundra from Lena to Kolyma rivers (northeastern Siberia); winters from Wallacea eastward through Australasia; prone to extreme vagrancy

breeds patchily in low Arctic to subarctic tundra bogs of northern Palearctic from Scandinavia to Kanin Peninsula (northwestern Russia); Taimyr Peninsula (northwestern Siberia) and Lena to Kolyma rivers (northeastern Siberia); winters Paleotropical coasts from eastern Africa, Red Sea, and Persian Gulf through southeastern Asia, Indonesian Archipelago, southern New Guinea, and Australia (except south and Tasmania)

breeds drier tundra from Yamal Peninsula to northwestern Chukotskiy Peninsula (northwestern to northeastern Siberia), including New Siberian Islands; winters southern Europe and Africa eastward through southern Asia to Taiwan and Philippines and southward to Melanesia; prone to extreme vagrancy

breeds tundra to taiga edge of North Slope of Alaska eastward to north-central Canada; winters Mexico and throughout the Caribbean; in Central America mainly along Pacific coast; coastal South America to Peru and northern Brazil, and in pampas of north-central Argentina

breeds coastal tundra of eastern Chukotskiy Peninsula to northern Kamchatka (northeastern Russia); winters coastal mudflats from Taiwan and east-central China to Bangladesh; mainly Thailand, Myanmar, and Bangladesh; rare and local

breeds coastal tundra of Taymyr Peninsula eastward to Chukotskiy Peninsula and northern Kamchatka Peninsula (north-central to north-eastern Siberia); winters coastal northeastern India and Sri Lanka eastward to southern Japan (Ryukyu Islands), Philippines, Australasia, and Melanesia

breeds tundra of Scandinavia eastward through northern Russia to Chukotskiy Peninsula (northeastern Russia), including New Siberian Islands; winters southeastern Europe southward to central Africa and eastward to central and southern Japan and Taiwan

breeds subarctic to temperate bogs of disjunctly in Chukotskiy Peninsula, northern Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia) and (perhaps) northern Mongolia; winters eastern India and Sri Lanka eastward through southern Asia to southern Japan (Ryukyu Islands) and southward to southeastern Australia

breeds high Arctic dry coastal tundra from Wrangel Island (northeastern Siberia) eastward through Alaskan North Slope to northeastern Canada, including Arctic islands from Banks to Devon; migrates to grassland of southeastern Brazil and Uruguay to central Argentina; prone to extreme vagrancy worldwide

breeds high Arctic tundra wetlands of Holarctic from northwestern and southeastern Greenland, Svalbard (north of Norway), north Taymyr Peninsula and Severnaya Zemlya (to the north), Lena Delta, and New Siberian Islands (north-central Siberia), Alaskan North Slope (rare), Canadian Arctic islands from Banks to Ellesmere and south to Southampton; winters sandy coastal beaches worldwide from temperate to tropical zone, in Old World from the British Isles and Atlantic islands through Africa, Malagasy region, Middle East, southern Asia through Indonesian Archipelago to Australia, Melanesia, Philippines, and southern and central Japan (but rare New Guinea and New Zealand); in New World, southwestern and southeastern Canada and Caribbean southward to Tierra del Fuego, and including remote islands of eastern Polynesia

breeds low (locally high) Arctic to temperate wet tundra of Holarctic, from southwestern and northeastern Greenland, Iceland, Faroe Islands, northern British Isles, Scandinavia, Baltic region east through northern Russia including Novaya Zemlya (north of northwestern Siberia) and New Siberian Islands (north of east-central Russia), through Chukotskiy Peninsula, western Kamchatka, northern Kurile and northern Sakhalin islands (eastern Russia); Aleutians, western and northern Alaska and northwestern Canada, and north-central Canada north and west of Hudson Bay; winters coastal and inland wetlands from temperate to tropical zones mainly north of Equator, from British Isles, western Europe, Mediterranean, northern and north-central Africa, Middle East, and northern plains of India to northern Vietnam and eastern China, Taiwan, Korean Peninsula, and Japan (Honshu to Ryukyu Islands); southwestern Canada and New England to west-central Mexico and Yucatan Peninsula

breeds montane tundra from Greenland and Iceland eastward through Arctic Europe and Russia to Taymyr Peninsula (north-central Siberia), also Banks to southern Ellesmere and Baffin islands (north-central Canada); winters rocky North Atlantic coasts from Iceland and Faroe Islands to western Europe, and Labrador and Gulf of St. Lawrence (southeastern Canada) southward to North Carolina

breeds coastal low Arctic to subarctic tundra of far northern Pacific from eastern Chukotskiy Peninsula to (disjunctly) southern Kamchatka, Commander and (perhaps) northern Kuril islands (eastern Russia), Aleutian and Bering Sea islands, western Alaska from Seward Peninsula to Gulf of Alaska islands; winters rocky subarctic to temperate coasts to Hokkaido (northern Japan) and central California

breeds high Arctic dry tundra from Wrangel Island to eastern Chukotskiy Peninsula (northeastern Siberia) through northern and central Alaska, northern Canada including Arctic islands from Banks to Ellesmere and Baffin islands, and northwestern Greenland; winters in mountains and coastally from southern Peru through Chile and southern Argentina

breeds wet tundra from Yamal Peninsula eastward to Chukotskiy Peninsula (northwestern to eastern Siberia), including New Siberian and Wrangel islands, also western and northern Alaska eastward through northeastern Canada, including Arctic islands; winters wet grassland and wetland edge mainly to Peru, Bolivia, and southern Brazil southward to Tierra del Fuego; prone to extreme vagrancy

breeds tundra from eastern Chukotskiy Peninsula (northeastern Siberia) through northern Alaska and eastward in northern Canada to northern Labrador, including southern Canadian Arctic islands from Banks to Baffin; winters coasts from Isthmus of Tehuantepec and Yucatan Peninsula (southwestern Mexico) and Caribbean to far northern Chile and northeastern Brazil

breeds Chukotskiy Peninsula and Anadyr (northeastern Siberia; few), St. Lawrence Island (Bering Sea), and western and northern Alaska mainland; winters coastal Washington to Peru and Galapagos, southeastern Canada to Caribbean, and inland central Mexico to northern Costa Rica

breeds drier tundra from northern Scandinavia eastward through northern Russia to New Siberian Islands (east-central Siberia); winters mudflats and marshes from southern Europe and Africa eastward to southern Asia and southern Japan

breeds tundra and taiga wetlands from eastern Aleutian Is through Alaska and Canada eastward to Labrador and Nova Scotia; winters mudflats and wetlands from southeastern USA, Caribbean, and Mexico southward to northern South America

breeds wet tundra from North Slope of Alaska eastward in coastal northern Canada to northwestern Hudson Bay, and Banks to Devon and Baffin islands (northeastern Canada); winters to wetlands of southern Chile, southeastern Brazil, northwestern to southeastern Argentina, and Falkland Islands
discontinuously distributed Sahel of sub-Saharan Africa

grassland, stubble, and scrub of lowland to hills from southern and eastern Pakistan (where rare) through sub-Himalayan region to southern India, east through Qinghai and to Amurland (southeastern Russia), southward through Nicobar Islands and northern Malaysia and to southern Vietnam; some withdrawal to south of northern populations in winter

grassland and scrub of lowlands to montane Sulawesi and Lesser Sundas eastward to southern and eastern New Guinea, northern and eastern Australia, and (at least formerly) New Britain (southeastern Bismarck Archipelago)

grassland, crops, and scrub of lowlands to mountains from northeastern and southeastern Pakistan east through sub-Himalayan zone of India southward to Sri Lanka and east through southwestern to eastern China, Ryukyu Islands (southern Japan), Taiwan, Philippines, through southeastern Asia and Indonesia through Sulawesi and the northern Lesser Sundas eastward to Alor
grassland, brush, and crops of lowlands and mountains of Luzon (northern Philippines)

dry scrub, savanna, and burnt areas in lowlands to mountains from far southern Iberian Peninsula (at least formerly) and northern Morocco; most of sub-Saharan Africa; southwestern Arabian Peninsula; northern and southeastern Pakistan east through eastern China, southward through India and east through Vietnam; Philippines (where rare), and disjunctly Java and Bali
grassland and woodland in Australia (except Tasmania)
savanna and scrub of northern, central and eastern Australia (Kimberley region, northern Western Australia, eastward to eastern South Australia)
Luzon (northern Philippines)
Sumba (Lesser Sundas)
Ghana to Kenya, Uganda, and southeastern Cape Province
mountains of South Africa (southwestern Cape Province to Port Elizabeth)
northwestern Australia (Kimberley region, northern Northern Territory) and offshore islands
northeastern Australia (Cape York Peninsula, northern Queensland); possibly extinct, last verified record 1924

wooded scrub and tussocky areas in lowlands and hills of southwestern Australia including Houtman Abrolhos Islands (off southwest); and southeastern and eastern Australia including Tasmania and islands in Bass Strait
coastal eastern Australia (southeastern Queensland, and formerly northern New South Wales)
Madagascar; introduced (?) Mauritius, Réunion, and Glorieuses

coasts of Indian Ocean, breeding on shores of northwestern Indian Ocean, Persian Gulf, and Red Sea; non-breeders regularly range southward to Kenya, Tanzania, and Madagascar, and eastward to western India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Chagos, and Andaman Islands (possibly breeds in the last four sites); also small numbers to northeastern South Africa, and to southwestern Thailand

tropical to subtropical stony plains of eastern and southern Africa, disjunctly in Djibouti, Ethiopia, and northern Somalia; southern Kenya, and Tanzania; and southwestern Angola to southwestern Zimbabwe and through South Africa
tropical bushland and open woodland from Ethiopia and Somalia through eastern Africa to northern South Africa and west to northern Namibia
open woodland of sub-Saharan Africa
tropical scrub jungle of Eastern Ghats of Andhra Pradesh (east-central India); extremely rare, with very few recent records
tropical to subtropical savanna of sub-Saharan Africa from southern Mauritania eastward to Eritrea and western Somalia, southward to northern South Africa
dry stony plains of north-central Pakistan, sub-Himalayan India, far southern Nepal, and far northern Sri Lanka

subtropical to tropical desert of western Paleotropics, from eastern Canary Islands and Cabo Verde, northwestern Africa, Middle East from southeastern Türkiye to Socotra, Iran, and western Turkmenistan to far northwestern India
semidesert in lowlands to hills from Eritrea and eastern Ethiopia throughout Somalia, southward to far southeastern South Sudan and east through southeastern Kenya; some intratropical migration
semidesert of southwestern Angola to Namibia, Botswana, and South Africa
breeds rocky coastal and river islets of northwestern and eastern Madagascar; winters coasts and estuaries of eastern Africa from southern Somalia to northern Mozambique
rocky rivers of tropical Africa from southeastern Gambia and Guinea-Bissau, disjunctly eastward to South Sudan and Ethiopia, eastward to western Kenya and southward to northern Namibia and Mozambique

breeds northern Australia (Kimberley region, northern Western Australia, eastward to inland eastern Australia and southward to northern Victoria); winters south-eastern Indonesia to southern New Guinea
eastern Afghanistan and Pakistan to India and Indochina
rivers of Mali to Cameroon, western Democratic Republic of the Congo, and northwestern Angola

breeds patchily in grassland near water from western India and Sri Lanka eastward to southeastern Siberia and Japan (central Honshu to Ryukyu Islands), southward to Philippines; winters grassy fields of Indian Ocean islands from Seychelles to Maldives, and Indian Peninsula and Sri Lanka eastward through northern Australia and the Mariana Islands and Bismarck Archipelago
breeds saline steppe near water from central Ukraine and southwestern Russia eastward to eastern Kazakhstan; winters in grassland near water of eastern Namibia, Botswana, and northern South Africa

patchily southern temperate to tropical grassland near water, from southern Europe and northern Africa through central Asia eastward to western Xinjiang (northwestern China) and northwestern India; also sub-Saharan river systems except far south

breeds mostly low Arctic tundra from Greenland, Iceland, and Scotland eastward to northeastern Siberia and Kamchatka, Aleutian and Bering Sea islands, through Alaska to east-central Arctic Canada (except northern high Arctic islands); winters to coastal waters of Africa, Persian Gulf, western India and Sri Lanka, eastward to Japan and Australasia, and southern South America

breeds Holarctic high and low Arctic tundra, locally in subarctic, from northwestern and southeastern Greenland, Arctic northern Scandinavia to northeastern Siberia and Kamchatka (eastern Russia); Arctic, western, and southern Alaska through Arctic Canada to Ellesmere and Baffin islands; in winter highly pelagic and mostly occurs southerly, to offshore subantarctic and subtropical waters off Africa, Madagascar, southern Australia, Peru, Chile, and east-central Argentina

breeds high Arctic tundra, mainly northwestern to northeastern Russia (including many high Arctic islands), northern and southwestern Alaska, eastward through Arctic Canada to Baffin Island (northeastern Canada); winters to temperate to tropical coasts and offshore waters worldwide

breeds Iceland, Faroe Islands, Ireland, Scotland, Norway including Svalbard, and northwestern Russia to Novaya Zemlya; winters North Atlantic Ocean offshore waters to central Gulf Stream of New England to North Carolina, northeastern Brazil, North Sea to Iberian Peninsula, western Mediterranean, Atlantic islands, and western Africa

breeds coastal Antarctica, especially Ross Sea; also South Shetland and South Orkney islands (off Antarctic Peninsula); winters to northern offshore waters and North Indian Ocean: mostly clockwise to Japanese and Korean waters and Gulf Stream of eastern USA, then southwestern Canada to northern Baja California and northwestern Africa
breeds coasts of southern Chile and southern Argentina; ranges north to coasts of southern Peru and central Brazil

southern oceans and coasts from coastal southern Argentina, Falkland Islands, Tristan da Cunha group (south-central South Atlantic), subantarctic and Antarctic islands from Cape Horn to New Zealand region

breeds North Pacific islands from Sakhalin and Kuril Islands, Hokkaido and northern Honshu (northern Japan), Aleutians, southern Alaska to southern California; winters coastal waters to southern Japan and Korean Peninsula and northern Baja California

breeds North Pacific coasts and islands from northern Chukotka and Sea of Okhotsk through Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia), off southeastern Hokkaido (northern Japan), eastward through Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians and southern Alaska southward to central California; winters offshore in North Pacific Ocean, and nearshore to southern Japan and southern California

breeds North Atlantic coasts from Greenland, Iceland, and Faroes eastward through Scandinavia including Svalbard, and Novaya Zemlya (northwestern Russia), also northern Hudson Bay to southeastern Canada and Maine (northeastern USA); winters offshore in North Atlantic and marginal seas, to North Carolina Gulf Stream and to Azores and Iberian Peninsula

breeds North Pacific coasts and islands from Wrangel Island eastward to Kamchatka, Kuril, and Commander islands (northeastern Russia), through Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians and patchily in western and southern Alaska southward to British Columbia; winters offshore and coastally in North Pacific Ocean, mostly in breeding range but southward to northern Japan
breeds Aleutians and islands off Pacific coast from Alaska through central Baja California; winters nearshore to off-shelf waters southward to southern Baja California

breeds North Pacific coasts and islands patchily from eastern Chukotka to Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia) eastward through Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians; winters offshore in North Pacific, to northern Sea of Japan and western British Columbia (southwestern Canada)
sedentary, North Pacific coasts and islands patchily from Sea of Okhotsk, Kuril, and Commander islands (eastern Russia) and Aleutians

breeds North Pacific coasts and islands, patchily from eastern Chukotka, Sakhalin, Kuril, and Commander islands (eastern Russia), Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians, and Gulf of Alaska; winters offshore in North Pacific, reaching northern Sea of Japan and western British Columbia (southwestern Canada)

breeds North Pacific coasts and islands, patchily from eastern Chukotka, Sakhalin, Kuril, and Commander islands (eastern Russia), Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians; winters offshore to Hokkaido and northern Honshu (northern Japan) and Gulf of Alaska

breeds coasts and islands off South Korea and western Honshu, Kyushu, and Izu Islands (central and southern Japan), south of Korean Peninsula, perhaps also far southeastern Russia; winters Hokkaido to southeastern Japan

breeds on forested or vegetated islands patchily from Kamchatka, Sea of Okhotsk, Sakhalin, Kuril, and Commander islands (eastern Russia), islands off Hokkaido and northern Honshu, and Yellow Sea, Aleutians, and Gulf of Alaska to western British Columbia (southwestern Canada); winters to Sea of Japan and southwestern Pacific coast of Japan, and southern California; prone to long-distance vagrancy inland, southern Canada and northern USA

breeds Cedros, San Benito, and Asuncion-San Jorge islands (west-central Baja California), islands in Gulf of California, including Rasa, and Tiburon, and Partida; winters to coastal central California and Jalisco (west-central Mexico)
breeds Guadalupe and San Benito islands (central Baja California, northwestern Mexico); winters offshore northward to coastal northern California
breeds Channel Islands (southern California) and islands off northwestern Baja California to San Benito (northwestern Mexico); winters offshore north to coastal Washington

breeds coastal strip up to 30 km inland in Kamchatka, Sea of Okhotsk, Sakhalin (eastern Russia), and northern Hokkaido (northern Japan); winters to coastal central Japan; prone to long-distance vagrancy to continental USA
breeds coastal strip up to 100 km inland from Aleutians to central California; winters to coastal southern California

breeds coastal strip up to 75 km inland, patchily from Wrangel Island, Chukotka, northeastern Kamchatka, and northern Sea of Okhotsk (eastern Russia), eastward to Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians and southeastern Alaska; winters bays and fjords in breeding range

breeds coasts of high Arctic to north temperate North Atlantic and Arctic Ocean from Greenland, Iceland, northern British Isles east through northeastern Russia; north slope of Alaska, eastern Canada including Hudson Bay; winters to ice-free waters near breeding range

breeds western North Pacific coast from Sea of Okhotsk, southern Kamchatka, Sakhalin, Kuril Islands (eastern Russia), Hokkaido (northern Japan), and perhaps northeastern Korean Peninsula; winters to central Japan and southern Korean Peninsula

arctic to temperate northwestern to east-central North Pacific coasts, from southern Chukotka to Kamchatka, Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia), Bering Sea Islands and Aleutians, and Gulf of Alaska to southern California; some withdrawal from north in winter

breeds rocky cliffs of low Arctic to north temperate North Atlantic coasts, from Greenland, Iceland, and British Isles to Scandinavia, northwestern France, and the White Sea (northwestern Russia), northeastern Canada to Nova Scotia and Gulf of Maine; winters south to Gulf Stream off North Carolina (western North Atlantic), and inland on St. Lawrence River; to Iberian Peninsula (eastern North Atlantic) and western Mediterranean Sea

breeds scree slopes of coasts of high Arctic from northeastern Canada and Greenland to Franz Josef Land and Severnaya Zemlya, north-central Russia; more rarely to Bering Strait; winters south in Gulf Stream to North Carolina, and inland on St. Lawrence River; to northern British Isles and North Sea
breeds cliffs of high and low Arctic (locally subarctic) Holarctic coasts; winters south of pack-ice, to coastal New York and northern Japan

breeds on cliffs of subarctic to temperate (locally Arctic) northern coasts, on the Pacific coast southward to southern Kuril Islands (northern Japan) and Channel Islands just off southern California; winters to Virginia in Gulf Stream (western North Atlantic); to Iberian Peninsula (eastern North Atlantic); to northern Japan in western North Pacific; to northwestern Baja California (northwestern Mexico)

breeds coastal USA from southern California to western Mexico and Massachusetts to eastern Mexico; river systems of South America from northern Colombia to central Argentina; winters coasts throughout Middle America south to south-central Chile
breeds major rivers and lakes of tropical Africa; non-breeders also on coasts
breeds very locally on major rivers, now mainly north-central and east-central India and central Myanmar; winters to coast of northwestern Indian Peninsula and Bay of Bengal
Fernando de Noronha, Trindade, Martin Vas Rocks, Ascension, and St. Helena islands (tropical South Atlantic Ocean)

Seychelles, Mascarenes, Chagos, and Maldives (Indian Ocean), and islands of southern Pacific from Iwo (Volcano) Islands (far southern Japan), islands off New Guinea, Lord Howe and Norfolk islands, and Kermadec to Hawaiian Islands (all island groups), Clipperton, Cocos, and Malpelo islands, and Henderson and Ducie Islands (Pitcairn Islands, eastern Polynesia)
breeds in native and exotic forest in Marquesas Islands; formerly also Phoenix and Line islands, and prehistorically westward to Micronesia and Samoa
widespread on tropical and subtropical islands of all oceans; ranges out to sea

tropical and subtropical Indian Ocean islands from Seychelles and Mascarenes to Chagos and Maldives (west-central Indian Ocean) and Houtman Abrolhos Islands (west of western Australia) and Ashmore Reef (northwest of Australia; race?); winters to east Africa, Comoros, and northern Madagascar
tropical and subtropical Pacific and Atlantic oceans, very locally northeastern Indian Ocean and Caribbean
subtropical South Pacific from Lord Howe and Norfolk islands (far east of Australia), Kermadec Islands (northeast of New Zealand) to sotheastern Polynesia and islands far west of northern Chile
tropical Pacific Ocean islands from far southeastern Japan and Micronesia to Gambier Islands (eastern Tuamotu Archipelago, Marquesas Islands, and Northwestern Hawaiian Islands

breeds North Pacific coasts from Sakhalin, Sea of Okhotsk, and Kamchatka (eastern Russia) eastward through Aleutians and to southwestern Alaska; winters coastal Thailand and Philippines eastward to New Guinea and east-central Australia; migrates along western North Pacific coast via Japan southward to Taiwan
widespread in all tropical and subtropical oceans
breeds islets of tropical Pacific from Marianas and Samoa eastward to main Hawaiian Islands; ranges to northeastern Melanesia and far eastern Polynesia
widespread tropical and subtropical islands, mostly near continents but also remote islands of eastern Polynesia and Hawaiian Islands
breeds coastal Namibia to Cape Province; winters to northern Angola
western to southeastern Australia, northern North Island (New Zealand), and New Caledonia

breeds southwestern Europe and southwestern Russia, central Asia, Mongolia to southeastern Russia, Japan (Honshu to Ryukyu Islands), eastern China, Taiwan, and Vietnam; northern and western Africa; Persian Gulf and Iraq to Indus Valley (Pakistan) and Gangetic Plain (north-central India); Sri Lanka; Gulf of Thailand, Malayan Peninsula, Singapore, and islands off Greater Sundas; off New Britain (southeastern Bismarck Archipelago), Bougainville (northern Solomon Archipelago); coastal Australia including Tasmania; and Saipan (southern Northern Mariana Islands, northwestern Micronesia); winters in southern portions of range
breeds large rivers from northern Colombia eastward to Guianas and southward to northeastern Peru and east-central Argentina; non-breeders concentrate mainly on coast and estuaries
breeds patchily on arid Humboldt Current coasts of central Ecuador southward to northern Chile; winters coastally in same region
breeds Red Sea and Persian Gulf to islands between India and Sri Lanka; apparently winters mainly Seychelles to Maldives and Cocos (Keeling) Islands

Great Plains to Texas and northern Louisiana; central California and Gulf of California coasts to Oaxaca (western Mexico), El Salvador, and Nicaragua; western North Atlantic coast from Maine to Florida, Gulf of Mexico, and Caribbean Sea from Bahamas to Lesser Antilles, islands off Yucatan Peninsula, Belize, and northern Honduras, and islands north of Venezuela; winters to coasts of northern South America
widespread on rivers and lakes east of Andes to north-central Argentina

breeds patchily coastal Baltic Sea and inland southeast Europe to western Mongolia and Ussuriland (southeastern Russia) and northeastern China and southern Asian coasts; coastal and inland western and southern Africa; Europa (west of southern Madagascar, Mozambique Channel), coastal Madagascar and Aldabra group (southwestern Seychelles); coastal and inland northern and eastern Australia, coastal New Zealand (North, South and Stewart islands); inland Northwest Territories to northeastern Canada, in south to central California and Great Lakes; winters to coastal Africa, Red Sea, Persian Gulf, India, Thailand, Malayan Peninsula, Vietnam, and southern Japan (Ryukyu Islands); eastern Pacific and Caribbean to Panama
breeds Australia (except arid areas); ranges to coastal southern New Guinea and Timor (eastern Lesser Sundas)

local yet widespread inland, rivers and lakes from southwestern Europe to northeastern China; coastal China; coastal western North Atlantic, and Caribbean; coastal southern California and Mexico; coastal South America and inland north-central Argentina; winters to subtropical and tropical coasts (including northern Australia), worldwide (except remote islands)
breeds islands off northern Peru to central Chile; ranges rarely northward to Ecuador
widespread in inland marshes of southern, central, and northeastern Eurasia, eastern and southern Africa, and Australia; winters inland Africa, Asia, Australia, and New Guinea
breeds braided riverbeds of South Island; ranges to coastal North and Stewart islands (New Zealand)

breeds inland south-central and eastern Europe eastward to north-central Siberia and northeastern China; winters Africa eastward to Philippines, Australia (except western deserts and Tasmania), and New Zealand
breeds inland temperate Canada, USA, and Europe to central Asia; winters coasts and offshore waters, western Africa, and Pacific and Caribbean coastal Mexico to northern South America

breeds coastal northwestern to southeastern Europe from British Isles and Baltic Sea to eastern Iberian Peninsula, Mediterranean, Black, and Caspian seas; coastal western North Atlantic from Virginia to Florida, Gulf of Mexico to southern Texas, Campeche Bank (north of Yucatan Peninsula), Belize cays, and West Indies; and islands off Venezuela and the Guianas, coastal eastern Brazil, east-central and southeastern Argentina; winters to coastal southwestern Europe and Mediterranean to Africa, Persian Gulf, India, and Sri Lanka; and to southern Peru and Uruguay

breeds islands off southwestern California and Baja California and Gulf of California (northwestern Mexico); post-breeding dispersal to coastal northern California, and wintering southward along Pacific coast to central Chile

breeds very locally islets off coastal Fujian, eastern China, and southwestern South Korea; winter range poorly known but mainly coastal southeastern China, Taiwan, northern Philippines, and coastal Seram (southern Moluccas); very rare

coasts of southwestern Africa, North Indian Ocean and marginal seas, through Indonesian and Australian waters from far southern Japan (Senkaku Islands, west of central Ryukyu Islands, and Nishinoshima, western Ogasawara Islands) to eastern Polynesia

breeds coastal southern California and Gulf of California to Sinaloa and Islas Tres Marias, and Atlantic from Virginia southward to Florida, Gulf of Mexico to southern Texas, and Caribbean including peripheral islands southeastward to French Guiana, and disjunctly coastal southern Brazil, Uruguay, and east-central Argentina
breeds coastal Mauritania to Guinea; winters to Morocco and Namibia

breeds disjunctly, coasts of south-central Mediterranean, Indian Ocean and marginal seas, and northern Australia; winters to subtropical and tropical Old World waters from northwestern Africa to New Guinea
rivers of Indus Valley (Pakistan), sub-Himalayan India, northwestern and central Myanmar, southwestern China, and southeastern Cambodia (formerly also southern Vietnam)
inland Indus Valley (Pakistan), sub-Himalayan India and Ayeyarwady River (central Myanmar); formerly to southern China and Vietnam

breeds inland central Alberta eastward to central Manitoba (south-central Canada) patchily southward to northern Baja California (northwestern Mexico), Colorado, and the Great Lakes, also North Atlantic coast from New Jersey to North Carolina, and Gulf coast southward to northern Tamaulipas (northeastern Mexico); winters to Gulf coast, Bahamas, Cuba, and southern Mexico
coastal lagoons and marshes of coastal Aconcagua to Llanquihue (central Chile) and southeastern Brazil and Uruguay to inland east-central Argentina

breeds circumpolarly, Arctic coasts and inland, from Greenland, Iceland, and British Isles eastward to Kamchatka (eastern Russia), through Aleutians, Alaska mainland through Arctic and subarctic Canada to southeastern Canada; winters subantarctic and Antarctic Ocean to edge of pack-ice
coasts and islands of southern South America and Falkland Islands
subantarctic islands of western and central South Indian Ocean: Crozet, Prince Edward, and Kerguelen islands
widespread in subantarctic and Antarctic islands of South Atlantic, South Indian, western South Pacific, and Antarctic Peninsula; winters north to southern Brazil and southern South Africa
coastal Kenya to Persian Gulf, Red Sea, and coastal Pakistan
widespread, subarctic, temperate, and locally tropical Northern Hemisphere; winters coastally to southern Africa, western Madagascar, southern Australia, and southeastern South America
islands off tropical Indian and Pacific oceans from Seychelles to Cook Islands (eastern Polynesia)
breeds coastal New Zealand, including Chatham and Auckland islands, also Furneaux group in Bass Strait; winters to southeastern Australia including Tasmania
patchily temperate to tropical Atlantic, tropical Indian, and subtropical to tropical western Pacific to Vanuatu
breeds Galapagos and Malpelo Island (far west of Colombia); winters to Humboldt Current off Ecuador to northern Chile

breeds Baltic region eastward to Sea of Okhotsk and southward to northern Kazakhstan and northeastern China, also rarely Great Lakes, Hudson and James bays (east-central Canada); winters North Atlantic coasts and North, Mediterranean, Baltic, Black, and Caspian seas

breeds western and eastern Greenland (rare), Arctic northeastern Siberia, locally from Taimyr Peninsula to Kolyma River, Arctic northeastern Canada and formerly Churchill, Manitoba (west-central Hudson Bay, east-central Canada); winters Arctic Ocean, in Beaufort (north of Alaska) and Labrador seas (at least)
breeds Commander Islands (southeastern Russia), Aleutian, and Pribilof islands, and St. Matthew Island (northern Bering Sea); winters Bering Sea to ice-edge and south of Aleutians

breeds on cliffs of high Arctic to temperate north coasts, from Greenland, Iceland, western Europe, Svalbard (north of Norway), north Siberian island to Sakhalin, Kamchatka, Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia); Aleutian and Bering Sea islands, western and southwestern Alaska mainland; Canadian high Arctic (northeastern Canada), Gulf of St. Lawrence and Newfoundland (southeastern Canada); winters to western North Atlantic coast and coastal waters south to Virginia; mid-Atlantic Ridge to Azores; North Sea; Japan (southward to Honshu) and Korean Peninsula, and southeastern Alaska to southern California

breeds patchily on Arctic coasts of Greenland, Svalbard, and Siberia eastward to Chukotka Peninsula, St. Lawrence Island, western and northern Alaska, and Arctic Canada; winters coastal and offshore waters of northern South America to northern Chile and western Africa from Angola to southern Africa

breeds high Arctic islands from Greenland, Svalbard, Franz Josef Land eastward to Herald Island (northeastern Russia) and northern Canada; winters Arctic Ocean pack-ice edge to southeastern Labrador, Greenland, and Bering seas

breeds Yellow Sea coasts from Liaoning to Jiangsu (eastern China) and Songdo (northwestern South Korea); winters coasts of East China Sea from Japan (central Honshu and Ryukyu Islands) and Korean Peninsula to northern Vietnam

breeds patchily on coasts and saline lakes from southern Iberian Peninsula to Central Asia, Pakistan, and coastal far northwestern India, also Mauritania and Senegambia; winters to coasts of Arabian Peninsula and western India

breeds boreal forest zone from southwestern Alaska mainland across Canada to eastern Quebec (southeastern Canada); winters eastern North Pacific coast southward to west-central Mexico, inland southeastern USA, western North Atlantic coast and offshore Gulf Stream southward to the Bahamas and Cuba

breeds southern Greenland, Iceland, and western Europe eastward across Russia to Yakutsk region (eastern Russia), southward through Caspian Seato northeastern China, also west-central Newfoundland (southeastern Canada); winters to Africa, southern and eastern Asia, and (rare) eastern North America

breeds inland Tibetan Plateau of Tajikistan, Xinjiang (western China), Ladakh (far northwestern India), and Tibet; winters inland and coastal Indian Subcontinent, southwestern China, and western southeastern Asia
coastal southwestern Namibia to southwestern South Africa

marshes, lakes, and coasts of Africa and South America, sub-Saharan Africa (except Congolian forest) and Madagascar; coastal Ecuador and Peru; coastal northeastern Brazil to northeastern Argentina and inland to Salta in the north and La Pampa in the south (north-central Argentina)
breeds inland and coastal southeastern Brazil, central Chile and Argentina southward through Tierra del Fuego, and Falkland Islands; some winter coastally farther north
breeds Andean lakes of far southwestern Colombia to south-central Chile and southwestern Argentina; some non-breeders move to adjacent Pacific coast
breeds mostly gravel riverbeds in South Island (New Zealand); winters to varied habitats of southern North Island
inland southern Australia and coastal throughout Australia; coastal New Zealand and outlying islands and New Caledonia
breeds coasts of southern Chile, Argentina, and Falkland Islands; some move north on coasts
breeds inland nitrate desert of Chile and at least formerly Peru; ranges to coastal Ecuador

breeds on flat islands off western North Atlantic coast of Maine to Florida and the Gulf of Mexico to southern Texas; Gulf of California to Colima (western Mexico); Caribbean, islands off Yucatan Peninsula, and islands north of Venezuela, Trinidad and Tobago, and to French Guiana; winters coastally to northern Peru and northeastern Brazil

breeds prairie marshes of western and northern Alberta eastward to southwestern Manitoba, and southward from east-central Oregon to northwestern Minnesota; winters coasts from Ecuador (including Galapagos) to central Chile
Galapagos coasts

breeds patchily on lake islands from Crimea eastward through Kazakhstan and Mongolia to Gansu, Qinghai, and Inner Mongolia (west-central China); winters to coasts, landlocked seas, and rivers from Black Sea eastward across Bay of Bengal to Bangladesh and south-central Myanmar

breeds lakes of northeastern Kazakhstan eastward to Transbaikalia (southeastern Russia) and Inner Mongolia (northeastern China); winters coasts of Korean Peninsula, Bohai Bay, Yellow Sea, and East China Sea
breeds coastal southern Portugal and Spain through Mediterranean and associated seas eastward to Cyprus and southern Türkiye; winters southward to coast of Gambia

breeds inland southern Britain and eastern Spain eastward to southwestern Russia, Ukraine, and Azerbaijan; winters coasts southern Ireland to west-central Africa, Black Sea, and Mediterranean and associated seas
breeds islands of Red Sea and associated gulfs; winters through Red Sea and nearby coasts
breeds islands of Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, Socotra, southward to northern Kenya and eastward to southern Pakistan; winters to central Tanzania including Zanzibar
sandy coasts of southwestern to southeastern Australia including Tasmania
western coast and islets of Humboldt Current of northern Peru to northern Chile; disperses to northern Ecuador and central Chile

breeds coasts and islets of eastern Siberia to Kuril Islands (southeastern Russia), Hokkaido to Kyushu and Izu Islands (northern and central Japan), Korean Peninsula, eastern China, and Matsu Island (off Taiwan); winters to southward, some reaching southern Vietnam and Philippines
breeds coastal southern Buenos Aires and Chubut (east-central Argentina); some winter to coasts of southeastern Brazil
coastal western Mexico; winters British Columbia to Guatemala

breeds inland British Columbia eastward to Labrador and Newfoundland (eastern Canada), Pacific Northwest states, and Great Lakes (northern USA); winters to coastal and inland southern USA, southern Mexico, Bahamas, and Greater Antilles

breeds Alaska mainland eastward to northwestern Alberta and southward to southwestern British Columbia (southwestern Canada); winters Pacific coast to central Japan (Honshu) and from southern British Columbia southward to northwestern Baja California (northwestern Mexico)

breeds mostly wetlands, subarctic and low Arctic of Palearctic from Iceland and northwestern and central Europe to Kamchatka (eastern Siberia), and in the south disjunctly in western and central Asia; winters Europe to northern Africa, Mediterranean, Black and Caspian seas, and Persian Gulf; disjunctly Sea of Okhotsk (southeastern Russia), Japan (Hokkaido to Kyushu), and Korean Peninsula to southeastern China
breeds islets in Gulf of California, from Roca Consag to La Paz Bay; winters to Salton Sea (southern California) and throughout Gulf of California (northwestern Mexico)

breeds on islands of western North Pacific coast from northwestern Washington to Isla Guadalupe and central Baja California (northwestern Mexico); some winter to southern British Columbia and southern Baja California

breeds inland southern Poland and Hungary eastward through Black, Caspian, and Aral seas to eastern Kazakhstan; winters southeastern Europe, Black Sea, eastern Mediterranean, Persian Gulf, and northern Arabian Sea

breeds coasts and islets of southern continents and islands, mostly in temperate to Antarctic waters, in Africa from Namibia around Cape through northeastern South Africa, and southern Madagascar; in Australia including Tasmania, and New Zealand and associated islands; in South America from northern Peru and southern Brazil south to Tierra del Fuego; and in subantarctic and Antarctic islands; some winter farther north

breeds northern and western Alaska eastward across subarctic Canada to Baffin Island and Newfoundland, southward on Pacific coast to southern British Columbia, eastward to inland northeastern USA and Atlantic coast southward to North Carolina; winters from Japan (southward to Honshu) and Aleutians southward on Pacific coast to Nayarit (western Mexico), Gulf coast, and inland to Honduras and northern Caribbean

breeds Arctic central and eastern Siberia from Taymyr eastward to Chukotka, New Siberian Islands, and St. Lawrence Island (Bering Sea); winters mostly to rocky coasts of Japan (Honshu to Ryukyu Islands), Korean Peninsula, and eastern China

breeds Altai Republic to Lake Baikal (south-central Russia) and Mongolia, Lake Khanka (Heilongjiang, northeastern China), and Yellow Sea islands (western Korean Peninsula); winters mostly to coastal wetlands of Japan (Honshu to Ryukyu Islands), Korean Peninsula, eastern China, and Taiwan

various coastal and inland open habitats near and away from water in Iceland, Faroe Islands, Scandinavia, the British Isles, northwestern Russia, and northern Europe southward to southern Poland, central Germany, and the western coast of France; winters as far south as the northern coast of Spain and northern Portugal, and apparently spreading to the Mediterranean coast in southern Europe
Atlantic coasts of Portugal, Spain, and Morocco; coastal and inland Mediterranean region from Belgium to Poland and Türkiye; winters to eastern British Isles and southern Scandinavia
breeds lakes of Caucasus to eastern Türkiye and northwestern Iran; winters to eastern Mediterranean, southern Black and Caspian seas, and Persian Gulf

breeds North Atlantic coasts, from southern Greenland and Iceland to Svalbard and Baltic states, and coastal and inland northeastern Canada to Great Lakes and Atlantic coast southward to New Jersey; winters to coastal southwestern Europe and coastal Florida

circumpolar breeder on (mostly) high Arctic coasts; winters coasts of Hudson Bay to northeastern Canada, Greenland, Iceland, northwestern Europe (northern North Atlantic); Sea of Okhotsk, Japan (southward to Honshu), southwestern Alaska, and southwestern Canada; widely vagrant farther south and inland

breeds from Greenland, Iceland, and western Europe to central Asia and north-central Siberia; winters mostly coastally to southwestern Europe, Africa (except southwestern and southern), India, and Sri Lanka, and eastern North America

breeds on islands in lakes and rivers of central Northwest Territories to central Manitoba (central Canada) to northeastern South Dakota; eastern Washington to Montana and southward to Colorado and central California; winters on coast from southern British Columbia (southwestern Canada) to west-central Mexico

breeds coastal North Pacific from eastern Siberia, Kamchatka, Kuril and Commander islands (eastern Russia) eastward through Aleutian and Pribilof islands, and southwestern Alaska to northern Washington; winters to Japan (southward to Honshu) and northwestern Mexico

breeds coasts and lakes of northeastern Siberia including Kamchatka southward to Kuril Islands (eastern Russia), and eastward to Hokkaido and northern Honshu (northern Japan); winters to coasts of Japan southward to Kyushu and Izu Islands, Korean Peninsula, Bohai Sea (northeastern China), and Taiwan; prone to extreme vagrancy
breeds on rocky cliffs of Arctic northeastern Canada to Greenland; winters coastal Iceland to northwestern Europe; Labrador to west-central North Atlantic coast; and east-central North Pacific coast
far southern Mexico to south-central Peru (Junín and Cusco), andVenezuela, the Guianas, Amazonian Brazil, and eastern Bolivia
patchily in montane forest of Grande Terre (New Caledonia)

breeds tropical and subtropical islands off northwestern Africa, northern South Atlantic, Persian Gulf region, southeastern Vietnam, northwestern Mexico to Ecuador, and Caribbean; pelagic when non-breeding in tropical and subtropical oceans: in Gulf Stream north to North Carolina, far out to sea in Atlantic, northwestern Indian Ocean to western coast of India, and central California to central Chile

breeds tropical and subtropical islands of South Indian and Pacific oceans; pelagic when not breeding, to waters off southeastern Africa, southwestern and eastern Indonesia, southern Japan, Taiwan, and eastern Australia

widespread breeder, all tropical oceans (except eastern Pacific and northeastern Atlantic); pelagic when non-breeding, to waters off eastern Africa, western and southern Sri Lanka, Indonesian Archipelago, and New Guinea waters, east-central Australia, and Gulf Stream north to North Carolina

breeds across the northern Holarctic region; winters coastally in the north Pacific Ocean from the Kamchatka Peninsula and Japan (Hokkaido to Kyushu) to the Yellow Sea, and from southern Alaska to northwestern Mexico; and in the northern Atlantic Ocean from the Maritime Provinces (Canada) to the southeastern USA, from Scandinavia south to the Mediterranean, and the Black and Caspian seas

breeds in southern Greenland, Iceland, and northern North America southward to northern tier of US states; winters from Iceland and Scandinavia southward to the Iberian Peninsula and from southern Alaska and the Maritime Provinces (Canada) southward to northern Mexico

breeds Arctic northwestern Russia from Novaya Zemlya eastward to Chukotka Peninsula, through northern Alaska and northern Canada to Nunavut (east-central Canada); winters to northern Norway, Japan (northern Honshu), Korean Peninsula, and coastal British Columbia (southwestern Canada); prone to extreme vagrancy

breeds coastal eastern Siberia and northern North America eastward through northern Canada to Baffin Island and James Bay (eastern Canada); winters to Japan (Hokkaido to Kyushu) and southern Baja California
breeds Arctic to temperate northern and central Eurasia and far western Alaska; non-breeders to coastal southern European and western Asian seas, to Japan (Hokkaido to Kyushu) and Korean Peninsula

breeds on beaches of subantarctic islands, in Tierra del Fuego, Falkland Islands, South Georgia, South Sandwich Islands, Prince Edward, Crozet, Kerguelen, and Heard islands, and Macquarie Island (southeast of Australia); disperses widely at sea mostly around Antarctic Convergence
breeds in scattered colonies on Antarctic continent edge and up to 200 km from open sea; ranges Antarctic seas to edge of ice pack and beyond, juveniles dispersing most widely
breeds circumpolarly along coastline of Antarctica and associated islands; winters near edge of ice pack
breeds on Antarctic Peninsula and associated islands, including Balleny Island (eastern Antarctica); winters mostly south of Antarctic Convergence, to southern South America and subantarctic islands
mainly subantarctic islands, locally Antarctic islands
southern Australia and North, South, Stewart and Chatham islands (east of South Island; New Zealand)
breeds coastal southern Namibia and southern South Africa; ranges to central Namibia and southeastern Africa
breeds coastal central Chile and central Argentina to Cape Horn and Falkland Islands; winters to southeastern Brazil
Humboldt Current region of coastal northern Peru to central Chile
coastal western Galapagos (Fernandina and Isabela)
very local on coasts of South (where now very rare), Stewart and satellites, Auckland, and Campbell islands (New Zealand)
subantarctic islands in South Atlantic Ocean and southern Indian Ocean
breeds on coastal slopes of Macquarie and nearby Bishop and Clerk islands (southeast of Australia); winters mostly near colonies, with juveniles ranging farther
breeds among rocks of Bounty and Antipodes islands (New Zealand); winters to waters of eastern South Island
breeds inland in forests of southwestern South Island, western and southern Stewart Island, and satellites (New Zealand); winters to seas south of Australia
breeds coastal forest of Snares Islands; disperses westward to waters off southeastern Australia, and northward off New Zealand
breeds among coastal rocks and tussocks of Tristan da Cunha group and Gough (South Atlantic), and St. Paul and Amsterdam islands (South Indian Ocean)
breeds far southern Chilean islands of Magallanes Province to Cape Horn Archipelago and Falkland Islands; winters northward along Patagonian coast
breeds coastally on Prince Edward, Crozet, Kerguelen, Heard (southern Indian Ocean), Macquarie (southeast of Australia), and Auckland, Campbell, and Antipodes islands (New Zealand)
breeds Española (Galapagos) and Isla La Plata off Ecuador; ranges to coastal waters of Ecuador and northern Peru
breeds Torishima (Izu Islands) and Senkaku Islands; ranges through North Pacific

breeds Senkaku, Izu, and Ogasawara (Bonin) islands (southern Japan) and Hawaiian Islands (most of population; Northwestern to islets in main group); ranges North Pacific from Bering Sea to Tropic of Cancer

breeds Ogasawara (Bonin) Islands (rare; formerly also Torishima, southern Japan), northwestern Hawaiian Islands (most of population, Northwestern eastward to Oahu), and Guadalupe and Revillagigedo islands (western Mexico); ranges North Pacific
breeds Enderby Island (Auckland Islands) and Campbell Islands (New Zealand); ranges all south temperate and subantarctic oceans
breeds mostly Sisters and Forty Fours (Chatham Islands), also Otago Peninsula of southeastern South Island (New Zealand); ranges all southern temperate and subantarctic oceans, mostly Pacific
breeds Inaccessible and Gough islands (Tristan da Cunha group); ranges subtropical and temperate southern Atlantic Ocean
breeds Chatham, Antipodes, Auckland, and Campbell islands (east and south of South Island, New Zealand); non-breeders to Tasman Sea (off southeastern Australia) and southeastern Pacific
breeds high-latitude islands of South Georgia, Prince Edward, Crozet, Heard, Kerguelen, and Macquarie islands; ranges all southern oceans
breeds Amsterdam Island (French subantarctic islands); ranges mainly south Indian Ocean
breeds circumpolar subantarctic islands; ranges through subantarctic and Antarctic oceans
breeds temperate zone islands of South Atlantic and south Indian oceans; ranges through temperate zone of those oceans
breeds Tristan da Cunha and Gough islands; ranges southern oceans
breeds on southern Indian Ocean islands; ranges mainly southern Indian Ocean between Tropic of Capricorn and Subtropical Convergence
breeds circumpolar high southern latitudes; ranges southern oceans mostly south of South Polar Front

breeds islands of south Chile, Falkland, South Georgia, and South Sandwich (southeast of South Georgia), Crozet, Heard, Kerguelen (South Indian Ocean), Macquarie (far southeast of Australia), Antipodes, Snares, and Campbell groups (southeast and south of South Island, New Zealand), and Campbell and Jeanette Marie islands (Campbell Islands, south of South Island, New Zealand); non-breeders are widespread all southern oceans from north of Antarctic Convergence to Tropic of Capricorn

breeds islets of northwestern North Island (rare), Chatham Islands (east of South Island), west of Stewart Island, and Snares (south of South Island, New Zealand); non-breeders to Australian waters and western coast of South America
breeds Tasmania and Auckland Islands (south of South Island, New Zealand); non-breeders to southern Indian and Pacific oceans
breeds mostly Bounty Islands, a few in Snares and Crozet islands; ranges to temperate and subtropical waters off southeastern Australia, western South America, and southern Africa
breeds Pyramid Rock (Chatham Islands); ranges in Humboldt and Magellanic currents off southern Peru and Chile

breeds islets in southern Chilean fjords and Cape Horn Archipelago; many islands, coasts, and inland sites in Antarctica; Falkland, South Georgia, Crozet, Heard, Kerguelen (southwestern to southeastern Indian Ocean), and Macquarie islands (far southeast of Australia); non-breeders throughout world oceans except tropical and North Pacific
known only from waters near Chiloé Island (Reloncavi Sound and the Chacao Channel), Chile
breeds Chungunga Island (Coquimbo, central Chile) at least; probably also Galapagos; non-breeders range Humboldt Current from Ecuador to central Chile and Galapagos

breeds circumpolar subantarctic islands in Falkland Islands, South Georgia, Gough (Atlantic), Crozet and Kerguelen (Indian Ocean), Macquarie (few; Australia), Chatham, Antipodes, and Auckland (New Zealand) islands; ranges mainly between Antarctic and Subantarctic convergences, northward to southern Tasman Sea and about 35°S

breeds Salvage (northwest of Canary Islands), Canary Islands, and Cabo Verde, Tristan da Cunha group including Gough (south-central Atlantic Ocean), southern Australian islets, and New Zealand region; non-breeders range to subtropical waters in North and South Atlantic, northwestern and tropical Indian Ocean to Seychelles, and southeastern Pacific Ocean
breeds New Caledonia; ranges from the Coral Sea (just off eastern Australia) eastward to Samoa and the Marquesas Islands

breeds tropical and subtropical southern ocean islands: south-central Indian Ocean islands, Lord Howe Island (far east of Australia), Kermadec Islands (northeast of North Island, New Zealand), Rapa (Austral Islands, eastern Polynesia), San Felix and San Ambrosio (Easter Island, southeastern Polynesia), and Juan Fernandez Islands (far west of central Chile); non-breeders range tropical and subtropical southern oceans between Equator and Subtropical Convergence
breeds Little Barrier Island (northern North Island, New Zealand); ranges to seas off southeastern Australia and Fiji

breeds circumpolar subantarctic islands of South Georgia, Antarctic Peninsula, Bouvetoya (southwest of Africa), Tristan da Cunha perhaps including Gough Island (south-central Atlantic Ocean); Prince Edward, Crozet, and Kerguelen (southwestern to southeastern Indian Ocean), Bounty, Antipodes, and Auckland islands (southeast and south of South Island, New Zealand); non-breeders range southern oceans mostly south of Equator to Antarctic Convergence
islets of northeastern North Atlantic from southern Iceland and central Norway to northern Spain, Canary Islands, western Africa, and western and north-central Mediterranean Sea

breeds islands off northern Kuril and Commander islands (southeastern Russia), Aleutians, and Gulf of Alaska to northern California; non-breeders range to northeastern coast of Japan, southern Sea of Okhotsk, northern Bering Sea, and central Californian coast
breeds in winter on Cabo Verde; present all year around Cabo Verde, and extent of at-sea range unknown, possibly to eastern North America

breeds on northeastern Atlantic islands, islets near St. Helena and Ascension islands, in Pacific off central Japan (northeastern Honshu), Hawaiian Islands (Kauai), and the Galapagos; ranges in Atlantic to Gulf Stream, Gulf of Mexico, western Africa including Gulf of Guinea, in North Pacific, seas off Japan, the Marquesas Islands, near the main Hawaiian Islands, and coasts of southern Central America to northwestern South America
breeds in summer on Azores; present Azores mainly April-August, and extent of at-sea range unknown, possibly to eastern North America

breeds islands off California and Baja California, including Gulf of California, from Channel Islands southward to Islas de San Benito (off central Baja California); ranges coastal waters northward to central California and southward to northern Peru

breeds off Paracas Peninsula (southern Peru) and Atacama Desert to mountains 50 km inland between Arica and Iquique (northern Chile); ranges east-central Pacific to coasts of southern Mexico, Galápagos, and central Chile
breeds Islas San Benito (central Baja California) and islands in Gulf of California; ranges coastal waters from southern California to Ecuador

breeds islands of northern Galapagos and off coasts of central Peru and north-central Chile; non-breeders range from coastal central Baja California (including southern Gulf of California, northwestern Mexico) to northern Chile, and tropical Pacific to southeast of Hawaiian Islands
breeds Atacama Desert, mostly in mountains well inland (northern Chile); ranges Humboldt Current of southern Ecuador to north-central Chile

breeds islands off California and northern Baja California, from Mendocino County (northwestern California) patchily southward to Isla Todos Santos (northwestern Baja California); ranges coastal California Current to northern California (including Monterey Bay) and north-central Baja California

breeds Izu, Ogasawara (Bonin), and at least formerly Iwo (Volcano) Islands (southern Japan), and Northwestern Hawaiian Islands; ranges eastern coastal waters of Japan and eastward to Hawaiian Islands (Kauai)

breeds mainly islands off Honshu, Japan, also islets off southeastern Russia, Korean Peninsula, eastern China, and Taiwan; ranges through eastern Indonesian Archipelago to southern India and Sri Lanka, Arabian Sea, and off northeastern African coast; recent records from Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean

breeds Iwo (Volcano) Islands, possibly also Ogasawara (Bonin) Islands (far southern Japan); disperses westward to Arabian Sea, Seychelles, and off eastern African coast, eastward to western Micronesia, seas of eastern Indonesia, and off northwestern Australia
summer breeder on islets off Guadalupe Island (western Mexico); ranges in eastern Pacific north to southern California and southward to ca. 10°N
winter breeder on islets off Guadalupe Island (western Mexico); nonbreeding range poorly known, but apparently disperses southward in eastern Pacific, at least as far as the Galapagos

breeds northeastern Atlantic from southern Iceland, Faroe Islands, central Norway, Ireland, and Scotland; northwestern Atlantic from southern Labrador to Massachusetts; northwestern Pacific from northeastern Russia and northeastern Japan (Hokkaido and northern Honshu) to Alaska and northern and central Baja California (northwestern Mexico); also off southwestern Africa; non-breeders range to tropical Pacific Ocean mainly north of Tropic of Capricorn, and tropical Atlantic, reaching southern Africa in temperate southeastern Atlantic Ocean
breeds satellite islets, coasts and to 440 km inland in Antarctica; non-breeders range near pack-ice in Southern Ocean
breeds Antarctic islets, coasts and mountains to 350 km inland; ranges Southern Ocean mostly near ice, south of Antarctic Convergence

breeds subantarctic and Antarctic islands and coasts; non-breeders range to tropics in cold waters of Benguela Current of southern Africa, southern Australasia, and Humboldt Current of South America north to Ecuador and southern Brazil

breeds islands and coasts of Antarctica to Heard (Indian Ocean) and Macquarie islands (Australia), and off southern Chile and Argentina; ranges coasts and open water of all southern oceans and cold currents, often south of Antarctic Convergence

breeds islands north of Antarctic Convergence from South Georgia to Macquarie (southeast of Australia) and Stewart, Chatham, Antipodes, Auckland, and Campbell islands (New Zealand); ranges coasts and open water of all southern oceans, mostly north of Antarctic Convergence
circumpolar in Antarctic, breeding islets and coast of Antarctica; ranges southern oceans from pack-ice to Humboldt Current off Chile and Peru

breeds islands and coasts of North Atlantic, bays between Arctic and North Atlantic, and North Pacific including Sea of Okhotsk to Hokkaido (northern Japan) and Bering Sea; non-breeders range to coasts of northwestern Pacific southward to central Japan, northeastern Pacific southward to Baja California (northwestern Mexico), western Atlantic southward to North Carolina, and eastern Atlantic southward to France

breeds Azores to Cabo Verde, Round Island (off Mauritius), Ryukyu, Izu, Ogasawara (Bonin), and Iwo (Volcano) islands (southern Japan), islands off southern China, Kiribati, Marquesas Islands, and Northwestern and main Hawaiian islands, including Johnson Atoll; ranges widely in Atlantic, reaching western Africa, widely in tropical Indian Ocean from Mascarenes eastward to New Guinea and northern Australia, and through tropical Pacific

breeds Socotra (Yemen) and Halaaniyat islands (Oman); ranges mainly northwestern Indian Ocean, including gulfs of Aden and Oman, off eastern Africa to waters of Seychelles and Mascarenes, eastward to western India and off northwestern Australia
probably breeds Gau Island (central Fiji); distribution at sea unknown but recorded in Fiji waters
breeds montane Réunion (Mascarenes); formerly also Rodrigues, where extirpated; ranges adjacent Indian Ocean to Seychelles, Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Timor Sea (off western Australia)

likely breeds montane southern New Ireland (Bismarck Archipelago); ranges eastern Bismarck Archipelago, widely in Solomon Archipelago, and Vanuatu; also recorded Cenderawasih Bay (northern New Guinea) and north-central Moluccas

breeds Grande Terre (New Caledonia), Gau (Fiji; southwestern Polynesia), American Samoa (central Polynesia), Society, Marquesas, and Gambier islands (southeastern Tuamotu Islands; eastern Polynesia); non-breeders range to tropical Pacific Ocean waters off New Guinea and northern Australia, and east-central Pacific coast of Mexico and Central America

breeds islets of south temperate and subantarctic oceans from Inaccessible and Gough (Atlantic) to Macquarie Island (southeast of Australia), Campbell and Antipodes islands (south of New Zealand); ranges circumpolar subantarctic waters
breeds Little and Great Barrier islands (off North Island, New Zealand); ranges to southeastern offshore Australian waters and east-central Pacific off Mexico southward to Ecuador
breeds coastal foothills of western South Island (New Zealand); ranges to southeastern Australian waters and Humboldt Current from northern Chile southward to Cape Horn
breeds Inaccessible Island (Tristan da Cunha); ranges to coast of southern Brazil to northern Argentina, and to southwestern Africa

breeds islets of south temperate and subantarctic oceans north of Antarctic Convergence from Falkland Islands to southern outlying islands of New Zealand; ranges widely in southern oceans, to southern coasts of southern continents and subantarctic islands

breeds coastal islands from Russian Far East, Korean Peninsula, and Japan to islands off western Taiwan; ranges western Pacific to Philippines, Indonesia, and northern Australia eastward through Melanesia to Micronesia
breeds Cabo Verde; ranges mainly in upwelling systems of tropical and South Atlantic
breeds Mediterranean islands and southwestern France; ranges mainly in upwelling systems of tropical eastern Atlantic

eastern Atlantic, breeding from Azores southward to Canary Islands and eastward to Galicia (northwestern Spain) and Berlengas Islands (off west-central Portugal); ranges widely in Atlantic, but mainly in upwelling systems of the Benguela and Agulhas currents

widespread in tropical and subtropical Pacific and Indian oceans, breeding on islets from Seychelles and Mascarenes eastward through Ogasawara (Bonin) and Iwo (Volcano) islands (southern Japan) and northern Australia, thence to Hawaiian Islands (widespread) and Revillagigedo Islands (off central Mexico); ranges from northeastern Africa and Malagasy region eastward to southern Baja California and southward to Panama

breeds Poor Knights Islands (off northern North Island, New Zealand); wide trans-Pacific dispersal northward to the Aleutians, also eastern Australia and western South American waters to central Chile
breeds islets off southern Australia, including Bass Strait and Tasmania; ranges to Antarctic ice edge waters, then to Sea of Okhotsk, Sea of Japan, and Bering Sea (North Pacific Ocean)

breeds southeastern Australia (including Macquarie Island), New Zealand including associated subantarctic island groups, far southern South America (including the Falkland Islands), and Tristan da Cunha (south Atlantic Ocean); winters northward in North Atlantic to Greenland and northwestern Europe, and in northern Pacific to Gulf of Alaska and western USA

breeds Tristan da Cunha group (mainly) and Kidney Island (Falkland Islands; few); ranges in Atlantic off southern South America and southern Africa, and northward to southern Greenland and northwestern Europe

breeds islets off St. Paul (central Indian Ocean), southern Australia, Lord Howe Island (east of Australia), North Island and Cook Strait (New Zealand); ranges to Arabian Sea, eastern Malagasy region, Sea of Okhotsk and Sea of Japan to Gulf of Alaska and western USA coast (rare)
breeds Juan Fernández and Mocha islands off central Chile; ranges inshore and coastal eastern Pacific Ocean waters northward to Gulf of Alaska and southward to southern Chile

breeds eastern Polynesian island groups, in Line, Austral, Marquesas, Gambier, and Pitcairn islands, Hawaiian Islands (Northwestern and islets off main islands), Easter Island, and Salas y Gomez; ranges westward to Micronesia and eastward to coasts of western Mexico southward to Costa Rica
breeds islets off larger Galapagos Islands; ranges to waters off west-central Mexico and Central America
breeds islets of northeastern North Island and Marlborough Sounds (northeastern South Island, New Zealand); ranges to Australian waters
breeds montane northeastern South Island (New Zealand); ranges to seas off western, southern, and eastern Australia

breeds islands of subarctic, temperate, and subtropical North Atlantic Ocean; non-breeders range to South Atlantic Ocean waters of Brazil and Argentina to Tierra del Fuego and southwestern Africa, mostly over continental shelves
breeds on Mediterranean islands and western Black Sea; ranges throughout Mediterranean and Black Sea and disperses to Atlantic coasts of southwestern Europe and northwestern Africa

breeds Elbow Cay (east of central Abaco, northern Bahamas), Long Cay (Exumas, east-central Bahamas), off northern Cuba, east of Puerto Rico, and the Lesser Antilles (Caribbean Sea); Crab Cay (Providencia Islands, east of Nicaragua); Tiger Cay (Bocos del Toro Archipelago, Caribbean northwestern Panama); islas Los Roques, Orchila, and Los Hermanos (north of central Venezuela); and islets of Fernando de Noronha (east of northern Brazil); non-breeders range to Gulf Stream north to New England (western North Atlantic) and Gulf of Mexico

breeds Azores, Madeira including Desertas and Salvage islands, and Canary islands; ranges (rarely) to coasts of southwestern Europe and northwestern Africa, and near shelf-slope break off New England (northeastern USA)
breeds Cabo Verde; ranges (rarely) to Canary Islands, northwestern African coastal waters and Amazon Reef (northeastern South America)
presumably breeds montane Bougainville, Kolombangara, and Rendova (northern and west-central Solomon Archipelago); non-breeders range westward to Flores, Moluccan seas, and Bismarck Archipelago

breeds Tristan da Cunha and Gough (Atlantic), and Chatham and Antipodes islands (New Zealand); ranges in South Atlantic to Falkland Islands and southwestern Africa, and widely in South Pacific from southern New Zealand to south-central Chilean coast
south-central Indian Ocean, islets off southwestern and southern Australia, and outlying islands of New Zealand
breeds Higashi-jima, northern Ogasawara (Bonin) Islands (southern Japan); ranges southern Japanese waters but originally discovered on Midway Island (Hawaii)

breeds Khuriya Muriya Islands (south of Oman), Socotra, and Moheli (=Mwali, Comoros); non-breeders range Arabian Sea to Persian Gulf, Gulf of Aden, Red Sea, Comoros (southwestern Indian Ocean), and western coast of India
breeds tropical Indian Ocean in Malagasy region and tropical Pacific Ocean from Vanuatu through Austral, Marquesas, and Gambier islands (eastern Polynesia)
breeds islands off western coast of Baja California and northern Gulf of Mexico; ranges to central California inshore waters, Gulf of California, and inshore waters of west-central Mexico
breeds Ogasawara (Bonin) and Iwo (Volcano) islands (far southern Japan); ranges in Japanese waters
breeds Rapa Island (Austral Islands); non-breeding range unknown
breeds mountains of Revillagigedo Islands (off western Mexico); ranges to coastal waters from southern Baja California to Oaxaca (western Mexico)

breeds mountains of Hawaiian Islands (mainly Kauai, but also Molokai, Maui, and Hawaii); ranges to waters south of Japan and Mariana Islands and to southwestern Pacific near New Caledonia, Solomon Archipelago, and Vanuatu
